E-Sys MAX 5.2.7

New
- More languages (beta): Turkish, Italian, Spanish, Korean and Chinese, in the launcher, inside E-Sys and in the coding ideas. Choose yours in Settings.
- German, Russian and Romanian are now complete: every window inside E-Sys is translated too.

Improved
- Every window fits its text in every language: longer words wrap instead of being cut, buttons never cover each other.
- Buttons named in messages match the buttons on screen in every language.
- Wider list columns where a translated title needs the room.

Includes everything in 5.2.6.

Your licence and settings stay the same after updating.

Thank you for using E-Sys MAX.
